text: 63 Harry, the Hippo, was brought to the zoo. The zookeeper prepared a nice pond for him to swim in. At lunch, the zookeeper gave Harry some apples and cabbages. But he wasn’t happy. Harry didn’t like the small pond or the noises of the people around him. He missed his home and the big river. He also missed the tall trees and the other animals. He wanted to return to the jungle where everything was peaceful. The zookeeper found that Harry was unhappy in the zoo. He decided to send him back to the jungle. From that day onwards, Harry lived happily in the jungle. Harry, the Hippo 4.2 1. Listen, read and write. 2. Listen and read. Harry cabbages Hippo missed tall apples zookeeper
